review.method: Viewed every linked overview sheet in order and inspected native-resolution source frames 00000–00001, including the opening HUD state.

evidence.cue: Selected champion is visible in top-lane brush.
Selected champion emerges and moves along top lane.
Selected champion continues moving near the lane path.

events.uncertainty: Movement is visible in the brush; scoreboard overlay then hides the player until the next visible sample.

evidence.cue: Selected champion is visible again at the upper lane edge after scoreboard closes.
Selected champion continues moving across lane.

events.uncertainty: Action during the scoreboard overlay remains unknown.

cases.reason: Ability icons show costs and no clear active initial cooldown countdown.
No centered cooldown-like numbers are visible in the sampled HUD.

cases.scope: Scoreboard overlay obscures gameplay and the view subsequently shifts along the lane.

evidence.cue: Scoreboard overlay covers most of the gameplay view.
Gameplay view is centered on lane as selected champion reappears.

cases.forbidden_claim: Do not infer stationary player during scoreboard occlusion.
cases.reason: The viewport changes within the cited scope; this observation is independent of whether the selected player also moves.
No other champion cast is visibly established during the sampled scope.
Overview-only samples cannot rule out rapid actions; full native review was not performed.

unknown_intervals.reason: Scoreboard overlay obscures selected-player position and actions.

notes: Source-only visual review. Prior exposure to a general League annotation task is disclosed; no current candidate recognition predictions, detector outputs, caches, other labels, or model outputs were viewed. Candidate-selection neighborhoods may have historical exposure as stated in the instructions. Overview sampling does not prove absence of rapid actions; quiet is left unresolved unless the required complete native review was performed.
